blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) and the National Center for Mental Health (NCMH) are strengthening mental health support for overseas Filipino workers (OFWs), their families and DMW frontline personnel as the country observes National Mental Health Week 2026. The NCMH said it continues to work with the DMW, DMW–OFW Hospital, SIGLA Wellness Centers and other partner agencies to make mental health services more accessible to OFWs and government personnel who assist them.
